summary: Implemented the feature without running any tests or repository code. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Converted SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler into thin adapters over the savers and plot function. Changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Updated output_path callers to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename, and added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. All tests are unexecuted. The plot tests only check that output exists and do not count images. Nothing was committed.
